title: Quick Roasted Brazilian Chicken Roast
description: A halal friendly Brazilian dish featuring roasted chicken, fluffy rice and a crunchy rice krispies topping, perfect for a post workout meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rice krispies, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and bitter melon powder.
In a separate pot, bring the water to a boil and add the uncooked white rice, reducing heat to low and covering the pot.
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Place the chicken breast in a baking dish and roast in the oven for 25 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the rice according to the package instructions.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
To assemble the dish, place a slice of the roasted chicken on a plate, top with a scoop of fluffy rice and sprinkle with the rice krispies mixture.
